director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ke shares jaise fractions dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein batting pasand hai ya bowling?
Koi baat nahi, Riya—batting ya bowling choose karna zaroori nahi. Socho: cake ko do barabar shares mein baantoge toh har share kaisa hoga?
Ek roti ko do bilkul same tukdon mein kaato: har tukda half, yani aadha. Dono tukde same size hain?
Dheere chalenge. Equal parts matlab sab tukde same size. Do same tukde hon, har tukda half hota hai. Kya dono tukde same hain?
Hindi mein? Zaroor. Riya, barabar hissa matlab sab tukde ek hi size ke. Ek roti ke do barabar tukde hon, har tukda aadha hai. Kya tukde barabar hain?
Riya, 5 se tum shayad paanch tukde keh rahi ho. Agar kul 3 barabar hisse hon, ek hissa 1/3 hota hai. Tum kitne kul hisse gin rahi ho?
Theek hai, Riya. Ab sirf problem padho: 1/3 of 15 pencils—15 kul pencils hain, aur 1/3 ek barabar hissa maangta hai. Yeh kya pooch raha hai?
Riya, board dekho: ek roti ke chaar barabar hisse hain. Puri roti ko kitne barabar hisso mein baanta gaya?
Riya, roti ko 4 barabar hisson mein baanta gaya hai. Ismein kul kitne hisse hain?
Riya, tumne 7 kaha. Picture mein roti ke 4 tukde dikh rahe hain. Ab 1/3 mein kul barabar groups gino.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.
